key.name: use-system-font
key.summary: Use the system font for messages
key.description: Whether message bodies are shown in the system font. When false, the font in “body-font” is used.

key.name: body-font
key.description: The font message bodies are shown in when “use-system-font” is false, as a Pango font description such as “Serif 12”. Messages that set their own fonts keep them. Empty means the system font.

key.name: monospace-plain-text
key.summary: Use a monospace font for plain-text messages
key.description: Whether plain-text message bodies are shown in the system monospace font, at the size of “body-font” when “use-system-font” is false.
